newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to auction C$2.4 billion bonds due 2007.
newsitem.headline: Canada to auction C$2.4 billion bonds due 2007.

text.p: The Government of Canada said it plans to auction on November 6 C$2.4 billion of bonds with a coupon of 7.25 percent and maturing on June 1, 2007.
The Bank of Canada said it will buy C$240 million of the new bonds.
The bonds, which will be dated and delivered on November 15, pay interest on December 1 and June 1, the government said.
The government said the new bonds are in addition to C$2.4 billion of 7.25 percent bonds due 2007 already outstanding.
Proceeds of the issue will be used for the general purposes of the Government of Canada, the bank said.
